issue.body:
### What happened?

I've run into a limitation that if there are multiple tags in the last commit, the gorreleaser selects the wrong one that I want.
For example, I released prerelease v0.9.2-beta2 and then from that same commit v0.9.2. So in the second case, goreleaser again took the v0.9.2-beta2 tag, and not v0.9.2. What to do if a commit has multiple tags. Some of them may be service and not related to the dependence on Semantic Versioning.

### How can we reproduce this?

First create tag v0.9.2-beta2 , next create tag v0.9.2. In both cases, the first tag will be selected.

repository.description: Protocol Buffer Validation - replaced by https://github.com/bufbuild/protovalidate

issue.body:
The goal of this change is to fix the symptoms described in the following two issues:
- https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/issues/1234
- https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/issues/1059

It seems the goreleaser action that was triggered by the 1.2.1 tag thought that the current tag was 1.2.1.SNAPSHOT.0
```
git state    commit=7b06248484ceeaa947e93ca2747eccf336a88ecc branch=HEAD current_tag=v1.2.1-SNAPSHOT.0 previous_tag=v1.2.0
```
Source: https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/actions/runs/12916704001/job/36021453853#step:5:21

Basically we ended up with two tags pointing at the same commit and goreleaser picked one: https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/issues/4134

We were unnecessarily increasing the likelihood of that happening by force fetching all tags (which is unnecessary because we will already have the intended tag fetched that triggered the push), so I removed that step here: https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/commit/87dc0be1d9b480a7636dcf9dd60ba239491c69e7

Additionally, I don't think there is any value in having snapshot tags at all so I deleted the entire version bump workflow here: https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/commit/79a4a4fd44ea52d9bed624d433ca5b26d170e96d

Furthermore, we had goreleaser configured to publish drafts, which doesn't make sense if we want to initiate release from the GitHub UI (which I think we do and is similer/easier) so I deleted all the extra config here: https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/commit/56f26d0f64a6f4d7b02a9af14d566cfe23eed857
The default config is the right thing for us.

Finally there were some settings in setup-go we had configured that have no effect now, so I removed them: https://github.com/bufbuild/protoc-gen-validate/commit/33528d7ea9428b8c6068f2b741bb659b371d8812
